name: Public sns:Subscribe is an exfiltration vector (critical)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 117. A bare Principal '*' Allow of sns:Subscribe on an SNS topic policy is a public wildcard-principal grant: the generic PUBLIC-ACCESS finding is critical. The shared messaging per-service rule ADDS MESSAGING-PUBLIC-EXPOSURE (high) naming the specific vector - anyone can attach an endpoint and EXFILTRATE every message published to the topic. Neither finding is narrowed; both keep the anonymous reach.

MESSAGING-PUBLIC-EXPOSURE: all AWS identities in all accounts
PUBLIC-ACCESS: all AWS identities in all accounts
